_comment: nwc_supports.py --families file: {substring of the Revit family or type name (case-insensitive): support CLASS}. Merged over the built-in map; keys starting with _ are ignored. Classes the built-in category rule accepts are CLEVIS, TRAPEZE, RISER, ROLLER; any other class (STAND, EQUIPMENT_FRAME ...) is written to the CSV and used by pcf_prep.py only when its job lists that class under support_rules.
